root_cause: Delivery recovery spent avoidable time serializing independent gates, chasing moving main before terminal landing, and treating a known failed historical production-readback as a hard terminal error instead of immediately proving the current live descendant.
prevention_rule: Schedule delivery by predicted critical path: fail cheap, parallelize independent expensive gates, preserve healthy exact-head evidence, coalesce main drift into one terminal reconciliation, and fall through from known failed canonical readback to authoritative live-descendant proof without weakening exact-head or production evidence.

secondary_incident.symptom: A redirect-only netlify.toml change plus closure evidence escalated to high-risk and ran full public-page visibility/header/full-regression browser checks.
secondary_incident.root_cause: Website risk treated every netlify.toml delta as high-risk and counted Brain learning/regression evidence as unowned website artifacts.
secondary_incident.prevention: Detect append-only canonical 301 redirect blocks as fast-fix, classify closure evidence as non-artifact, and run only baseline + preview + targeted browser proof for that bounded case.

terminal_gate_incident.symptom: A merged candidate could receive LIVE_BEWEZEN from terminal closure while an exact-head Required run later exposed a failing regression contract.
terminal_gate_incident.root_cause: Obligation Terminal Closure verified main/production/skill evidence but did not independently require exact-head Required, BRAIN and applicable Powerhouse CodeQL success before writing terminal state.
terminal_gate_incident.prevention: Terminal closure must read latest exact-head critical workflow outcomes and fail closed unless Required, BRAIN and applicable CodeQL are completed successfully before production/readback evidence is persisted.

website_risk_scope.rule: Fast-fix and normal-risk candidates use exact affected-route browser proof; sitewide visibility, header-menu crawl and broad browser contracts are reserved for high-risk candidates.
website_risk_scope.reason: Avoid sitewide Chromium work when the classifier already owns a bounded route set.
